# TPC-DS-OBT Q2 — obt_channel_distribution

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

Count sales rows by channel

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH wscs AS (
  SELECT
    sold_date_sk,
    sales_price
  FROM (
    SELECT
      obt.sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
      obt.ext_sales_price AS sales_price
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
    WHERE
      channel = 'web'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      obt.sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
      obt.ext_sales_price AS sales_price
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
    WHERE
      channel = 'catalog'
  )
), wswscs AS (
  SELECT
    obt.sold_date_d_week_seq AS d_week_seq,
    obt.sold_date_d_year AS d_year,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN (
          obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Sunday'
        )
        THEN obt.sales_price
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS sun_sales,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN (
          obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Monday'
        )
        THEN obt.sales_price
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS mon_sales,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN (
          obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Tuesday'
        )
        THEN obt.sales_price
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS tue_sales,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN (
          obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Wednesday'
        )
        THEN obt.sales_price
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS wed_sales,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN (
          obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Thursday'
        )
        THEN obt.sales_price
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS thu_sales,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN (
          obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Friday'
        )
        THEN obt.sales_price
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS fri_sales,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN (
          obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Saturday'
        )
        THEN obt.sales_price
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS sat_sales
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    obt.sold_date_d_date_sk = obt.sold_date_sk AND channel IN ('catalog', 'web')
  GROUP BY
    d_week_seq,
    d_year
)
SELECT
  d_week_seq1,
  ROUND(CAST(sun_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(sun_sales2, 0), 2),
  ROUND(CAST(mon_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(mon_sales2, 0), 2),
  ROUND(CAST(tue_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(tue_sales2, 0), 2),
  ROUND(CAST(wed_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(wed_sales2, 0), 2),
  ROUND(CAST(thu_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(thu_sales2, 0), 2),
  ROUND(CAST(fri_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(fri_sales2, 0), 2),
  ROUND(CAST(sat_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(sat_sales2, 0), 2)
FROM (
  SELECT
    wswscs.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq1,
    sun_sales AS sun_sales1,
    mon_sales AS mon_sales1,
    tue_sales AS tue_sales1,
    wed_sales AS wed_sales1,
    thu_sales AS thu_sales1,
    fri_sales AS fri_sales1,
    sat_sales AS sat_sales1
  FROM wswscs AS wswscs
  WHERE
    (
      d_year = 1998
    )
) AS y, (
  SELECT
    wswscs.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq2,
    sun_sales AS sun_sales2,
    mon_sales AS mon_sales2,
    tue_sales AS tue_sales2,
    wed_sales AS wed_sales2,
    thu_sales AS thu_sales2,
    fri_sales AS fri_sales2,
    sat_sales AS sat_sales2
  FROM wswscs AS wswscs
  WHERE
    (
      d_year = 1998 + 1
    )
) AS z
WHERE
  d_week_seq1 = d_week_seq2 - 53
ORDER BY
  d_week_seq1
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def q2_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    table = ctx.get_table("tpcds_sales_returns_obt")
    return table.group_by("channel").agg(ctx.col("sale_id").count().alias("sales_count")).sort("channel")
```
